nodes.title: LabelPal · Start Here

label_pal_v1.title: START HERE · MOSS Turbo AIO Setup
label_pal_v1.note:
1. **Requires ComfyUI 0.42.1+** (native `moss_image` support).
2. Place `moss_image_sft_turbo_int8_convrot_aio.safetensors` in `models/checkpoints/` — supplies `MODEL`, `CLIP`, and `VAE` in one file.
3. Publisher recipe: `8 steps`, `CFG 1.0`, `euler` / `simple`, `1024×1024` (native shift `5`, no extra Turbo LoRA or SLG needed).

- **Seed used** on Prompt Palette drives `KSampler` directly — roll seeds from Prompt Palette's toolbar!
